Queer in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 5 events

Queer and LGBTQ+ events in Amsterdam: parties, screenings, markets, meet-ups and shared dinners. There is something for everyone in the community and their allies, from quiet social evenings and creative workshops to big nights out. The list is refreshed every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  1. Film, Food & Solidarity: Pride (2014) at QueerHub Nieuw-West

    Film · Queer · Food

    When
    Mon 16 Nov, 18:00–21:30 (meal 18:30, film 19:00)
    Where
    QueerHub Nieuw-West, Notweg 38, Amsterdam (Nieuw-West)
    Price
    Free incl. meal; register
    Organiser
    Treehouse Rootz & Shewaken

    A shared meal and a screening of Pride, about LGBTQ+ activists who backed striking miners in 1984, followed by a talk in Dutch led by Rahma el Hannoufi. Film in English.

    Details and tickets for Film, Food & Solidarity: Pride (2014) at QueerHub Nieuw-West (organiser's site)

  2. Queerboxing — Basic Bitch Boxing at Lola Lieven

    Sport · Queer · Regular

    When
    Tue 17 Nov, 19:30–20:30
    Where
    Lola Lieven, Rodenrijsstraat 43, Amsterdam (Nieuw-West)
    Price
    Free; just walk in
    Organiser
    Lola Lieven

    A weekly free session on the basics of boxing and self-defence in a queer space: stance, punches, dodging, short combinations and games. No experience needed and no sign-up. Every Tuesday at Lola Lieven.

    Details and tickets for Queerboxing — Basic Bitch Boxing at Lola Lieven (organiser's site)

  3. Collectief FAKT — Omelas

    Theatre & Dance · Queer

    When
    Wed 18 Nov, 20:00
    Where
    Theater De Richel, Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal 282, Amsterdam (Centrum)
    Price
    €17.50
    Organiser
    Theater De Richel

    A queer theatre piece after Ursula Le Guin's 'Omelas': Emma falls for an activist film student and loses herself in her own activism. By a duo making more queer female stories for stage and screen.

    Details and tickets for Collectief FAKT — Omelas (organiser's site)

    Film · Queer

    When
    Thu 19 Nov, 20:00
    Where
    Pakhuis de Zwijger (Studio), Piet Heinkade 179, Amsterdam (Oostelijk Havengebied)
    Price
    €8
    Organiser
    Pakhuis de Zwijger

    Two short films on decolonising bodies, land and identity, a live talk with performance artist Daniel Hellmann — and a drag cow finale. In English.

  5. Lesvia + Mr. Dimitris and Mrs. Dimitroula

    Film · Queer

    When
    Fri 20 Nov, 20:30
    Where
    Filmhuis Cavia, Van Hallstraat 52-1, Amsterdam (Staatsliedenbuurt, West)
    Price
    €5
    Organiser
    Filmhuis Cavia

    A documentary on 40+ years of lesbian community on Lesbos and its friction with the island's villagers, by lesbian filmmaker Tzeli Hadjidimitriou, who grew up there, preceded by her short. English subtitles.
